description: Returns the public profile of one Shortlist business: name, type, description, town, phone, website, page URL, hours (fixed locations only), whether online ordering is open, and the order page URL when it is. Mobile businesses (food trucks) have no fixed address; their locations are the upcoming stops in the upcoming-events data.

subdomain.description: The business subdomain, e.g. "nitos" for nitos.shortlistpass.com

name: get_business
title: Get a business
